name: The Unwritten Frontier
frontierText: Beyond this edge, the world has not been written yet.

forms.label: Chamber
forms.description: The space gathers itself into a chamber with no obvious purpose.
forms.sitText: You sit where the room seems least certain of itself.

forms.label: Gallery
forms.description: A long room draws itself out ahead, narrow enough to feel intentional.
forms.sitText: You sit along the wall and let the length of the place stop mattering.

forms.label: Cistern
forms.description: The floor lowers into an old basin whose edges disappear into shadow.
forms.sitText: You sit above the basin and listen for a depth you cannot measure.

forms.label: Shrine
forms.description: The room arranges itself around a quiet center without naming what belongs there.
forms.sitText: You sit near the center. No devotion is demanded of you.

atmospheres.title: Still
atmospheres.description: The air is so still that small sounds seem to remain after they are made.

atmospheres.title: Warm
atmospheres.description: A low warmth rises from somewhere beneath the floor.

atmospheres.title: Echoing
atmospheres.description: Sound returns softly, never quite from the direction it left.

atmospheres.title: Overgrown
atmospheres.description: Pale vines have found seams in the architecture and made patient use of them.

materials.label: Stone
materials.description: Dark stone holds the shape of the room.

materials.label: Brass
materials.description: Thin lines of aged brass interrupt the surfaces like remembered handwriting.

materials.label: Wood
materials.description: Old wood appears where structure requires tenderness instead of weight.

materials.label: Glass
materials.description: Clouded glass catches light without revealing what might be behind it.

phenomena.title: Rain Room
phenomena.description: Rain falls through part of the room, although there is no sky and no visible source of water.
phenomena.inspectEcho: The water is real enough to touch. Its source remains politely absent.

phenomena.title: Borrowed Light
phenomena.description: A soft daylight occupies one corner, belonging to no window you can find.
phenomena.inspectEcho: The light has direction but no visible origin.

phenomena.title: Second Echo
phenomena.description: Every few moments, the room repeats one tiny sound that happened several breaths ago.
phenomena.inspectEcho: The repetition is exact, but it never chooses the loudest sound.

phenomena.title: Breathing Wall
phenomena.description: One wall expands and settles by a fraction, slowly enough that certainty takes time.
phenomena.inspectEcho: Stone should not breathe. This stone declines to discuss the matter.

objects.name: dry wooden chair
objects.inspectText: The chair is completely dry, even where the room around it is not.

objects.name: small brass token
objects.inspectText: One side is smooth. The other bears a doorway too small to enter.

objects.name: length of white thread
objects.inspectText: The thread has been cut cleanly at both ends. It is longer than it first appears.

objects.name: clouded glass bell
objects.inspectText: The bell has no clapper. Something inside it seems to remember sound anyway.
